provenance.notes: The Scientific Authority accepted the fixture-local body-axis signs, separate span/chord moment scales and r_CoM_to_aero_ref_B transport direction. The bundle has no product or Legacy dependency.

expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Frame, clock, sample, revision and coefficient-convention identities are exact; finite formula values use the fixture-local absolute-plus-relative tolerance.

expected_facts.claim: Each result carries the aerodynamic reference point, its intrinsic moment and a body-frame moment transported to the center of mass using r_CoM_to_aero_ref_B cross F_B.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Source, frame, configuration revision and half-open tick interval are exact; vector values use the fixture-local formula tolerance.

expected_facts.claim: The executable accepts zero dynamic pressure, rejects incompatible identity and invalid numeric domains, preserves two physical factorizations and detects three sign, scale and reference-vector mutations.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Equivalence, input rejection and mutation dispositions are exact.
